Privacy

Draft. This needs a legal review before the public launch.

Face data

Face matching is off until you turn it on. Your selfies are turned into a face signature (a list of numbers) on your device. The selfies are not uploaded. We store the signature and compare it only with photos in albums you have joined.

Other people's faces

When an uploader allows matching, their browser finds the faces in their photos and sends signatures to be compared. Those signatures are discarded after the comparison. We keep only who matched, and how many faces did not.

Deleting your face data

Turn off "Use my face for matching" in account settings. Your signature is deleted right away. Photos already delivered to you stay delivered. Deleting your account in account settings erases everything, including your uploads.

Photos

Only you and the people matched in a photo can see it. The uploader can see who it was delivered to. Hidden photo data is removed; we keep the date and a location rounded to about 1 km. Shared links work for 7 days for anyone who has them. Deleting a photo removes it for everyone.
